sections.heading: Subject-Matter Insured
sections.body: Raw materials, semi-finished and finished automobile components including castings, forgings, machined parts, brake assemblies and transmission sub-assemblies, packed in standard export / trade packing, belonging to the Insured or held in trust or on consignment, in the course of transit by road, rail, sea and air.

sections.heading: Voyage / Transit
sections.body: Inland transits from suppliers' premises anywhere in India to the Insured's factory at Ambattur, Chennai and from the Insured's factory to customers' OEM plants and warehouses anywhere in India; imports from any port worldwide to any port in India and onward to the Insured's premises; exports from Chennai / Kamarajar Port to any port worldwide. Transit by registered carriers only.

sections.heading: Conditions and Clauses
sections.body: Inland transit: Inland Transit Clause (A) - All Risks. Imports and exports: Institute Cargo Clauses (A) 1/1/09, Institute War Clauses (Cargo) 1/1/09 and Institute Strikes Clauses (Cargo) 1/1/09. Basis of valuation: CIF plus 10% for imports and exports; invoice value plus freight for inland transits. Excess: 0.5% of the sum insured per consignment, subject to a minimum as stated in the policy wording. Declarations of all despatches are to be submitted monthly by the 10th of the following month.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: In the event of loss or damage, notify the nearest office of the Insurer immediately and in no case later than 7 days of delivery, lodge a monetary claim with the carrier within the statutory period and obtain a survey report. Submit the claim form, original invoice, packing list, lorry receipt / bill of lading, carrier's acknowledgement of short or damaged delivery and survey report. Claims are payable in India in Indian Rupees.

sections.heading: Important Notice
sections.body: This schedule is to be read together with the policy wording and endorsements attached, which form part of this contract. Please examine the schedule and inform the Insurer of any discrepancy within 15 days. For grievance redressal contact the Grievance Officer at the Chennai Divisional Office or approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Chennai. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.
